EGFR_that_is_never_smoker.label: EGFR-driven tumours in people who never smoked

never_smoker_that_is_EGFR.label: Never smokers whose tumour is EGFR-driven

KRAS_that_is_never_smoker.label: KRAS-driven tumours in people who never smoked

never_smoker_that_is_KRAS.label: Never smokers whose tumour is KRAS-driven

concordance.note: A referral-centre cohort of adenocarcinomas in which 32% never smoked, so EGFR is over-represented against unselected disease. Only 10 patients are recorded as current smokers; read that column as too small to interpret on its own.

hist-adeno.cohort_note: Resected tumours from the TCGA pan-lung analysis, mostly early-stage and unselected for driver — unlike the referral cohort behind the driver axis.

hist-squamous.cohort_note: Resected tumours from the TCGA pan-lung analysis.

cohort.name: Small Cell Lung Cancer (U Cologne, Nature 2015)

hist-sclc.cohort_note: 120 tumours sequenced whole-genome (George et al, Nature 2015). Small-cell lung cancer is rarely resected, so any sequenced cohort of it is small.

cohort.name: Lung Adenocarcinoma Met Organotropism (MSK, Cancer Cell 2023)
cohort.filter: PRE_SAMPLE_TARGETED = No; EGFR L858R or exon 19 deletion

res-naive.cohort_note: Tumours with a sensitising EGFR mutation, sampled before any targeted therapy was recorded. One sample per patient.

cohort.name: Lung Adenocarcinoma Met Organotropism (MSK, Cancer Cell 2023)
cohort.filter: PRE_SAMPLE_TARGETED = Yes; EGFR L858R or exon 19 deletion

res-treated.cohort_note: The same genotype, sampled after targeted therapy. The study records THAT a targeted therapy preceded the sample, not which drug.
